capabilities: Export notes or folders to PDF or HTML from a note picker, right-click menu, or commands
Convert wikilinks between exported notes into clickable links to notes or headings
Add PDF bookmarks, an optional cover page, contents list and page numbers
Render notes through Obsidian, including callouts, embeds, math, images and plugin output
Configure page size, orientation, margins, output folder and per-note vs single-document output
extras: Desktop only for PDF; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installable via BRAT; no network use, accounts or payments.
intentEvidence: An independent port of Starnote's export.
problem: Obsidian's built-in printing does not turn wikilinks into working links between exported files or add document furniture like a cover page and contents.

relations.evidence: An independent port of Starnote's export.

summary: Note exporter that produces PDF or HTML files with clickable links between exported notes, plus cover page, contents and page numbers.
